name: Locked wide: she waits in the alley mouth, the clock reads 11:59
camera: Locked wide at eye level (1.5 m), 50 degree lens, 7 m behind and right of the bike inside the alley; bike and courier on the left third, the glowing package on the rack, the clock tower at the end of the avenue reading 11:59. Hard cut at 3.0.
what: The courier sits upright on the red motorbike at the alley mouth, both hands on the grips, engine idling, facing up the avenue toward the clock tower.

name: Close: the glowing package; she tightens her glove
camera: Close from the left rear quarter at 1.5 m height, 40 degree lens, slow push; focus racks from the package (3.0-4.0) to her hands (by 4.45). Hard cut at 5.5.
what: The yellow package glows on the rack. 3.6-4.8 she lifts her left hand off the grip and with her right hand tugs the cuff of her left glove twice, head bowed toward it; 4.8 both hands back on the grips; 4.9-5.4 she lifts her head toward the clock.

name: Low chase-cam: burnout, the SUV lights up behind
camera: Low chase-cam 0.5 m off the ground, 4.5-5.5 m behind and right of the bike, 66 degree lens; tracking subject = Bike. Hard cut at 8.0.
what: 5.55-6.4 burnout: rear wheel spins in place, white tyre smoke billows out to her left; 6.4 she launches up the alley. 5.8 headlights flood the alley from behind; 7.4-8.0 the black SUV's nose pushes into the left of frame, the dark driver visible through the windscreen.

name: High crane: weaving through traffic, SUV behind
camera: High crane, 15 m up dropping to 11 m, behind and right, slow push-in from 19 to 12 m, 46 degree lens; tracking subject = Bike. Hard cut at 11.0.
what: She weaves left and right between slower car boxes in both lanes at about 20 m/s; the black SUV holds the centre line 6-10 m behind her.

name: Wheel height: the SUV smashes the fruit stall
camera: Side tracking at wheel height (0.45 m) from the empty far lanes, looking across the market, 56 degree lens, moving with the bike; bike held on the left third (tracking subject = Bike). Hard cut at 13.5.
what: 12.1 she swerves left round a fruit stall in the outer lane; 12.6 the SUV clips it and smashes through: the table, crates and awning fly, oranges burst up and bounce across the road.

name: Front tracking: the drawbridge rises, she goes for it
camera: Front tracking, wide (62 degrees): the lens backs north over the bridge 8-6.5 m ahead of the bike, rising from 2.2 to 6.2 m as the leaves rise under it. Hard cut at 16.0.
what: 13.4 red warning lights flash and both bridge leaves start to rise. She does not slow: 15.0 she rides onto the rising near leaf, 15.6 leaves its tip at about 20 degrees and is airborne.

name: Worm's-eye, slow motion: airborne over the gap
camera: Worm's-eye from the road surface on the far bank (0.35 m), 32 degree lens, looking up at the bike against the night sky with the raised leaves behind it. Slow motion 16.1-18.1 (30 % from 16.45 to 17.75). Hard cut at 18.5.
what: In slow motion she flies over the gap, bike level then nose dipping, highest point at 17.2 s about 9 m above the deck; the package glows; she crouches over the tank.

name: Top-down: the SUV brakes, noses over, splash
camera: Straight top-down from 27 m, lowering to 23 m, 52 degree lens, north at the top of frame. Hard cut at 21.0.
what: The SUV brakes hard up the rising near leaf, tyre smoke streaming behind; 18.8 it reaches the tip still rolling, its nose tips over the edge; it pitches down and drops into the gap; 20.33 it hits the water: a crown of light-blue splash bursts up.

name: First person: through the tunnel
camera: First person from just behind the handlebars, 1.45 m, 80 degree lens; red fairing at the bottom of frame. Hard cut at 24.0.
what: She races through the road tunnel at about 18 m/s, strip lights streaking past overhead and on both walls; 21.4 she overtakes a car on its right.

name: Aerial spiral: up the rooftop ramp
camera: Aerial spiral pull-back: starts 6 m in front of the tunnel mouth, swings 150 degrees round her west side while rising to 7.5 m and pulling back to 14 m, 52 degree lens. Hard cut at 27.0.
what: 24.34 she bursts out of the tunnel and rides straight up the concrete ramp toward the roof.

name: Symmetric pull-back: she stops as the clock strikes 12
camera: Symmetric aerial pull-back on the helipad axis, the clock tower straight beyond: from 7 m back and 3 m up to 15 m back and 7.5 m up by 28.7, then held. Manual focus pulls from the bike to the clock face at 28.4.
what: 27.17 she crests the ramp onto the roof, brakes and skids the bike round 180 degrees in white smoke, stopping on the H facing the tower at 28.39; at that moment the clock's minute hand clicks to 12:00 and the faces flash brighter; she sits up and looks at the clock.
